name: onyx
description: Grounds every prompt in your Onyx knowledge base and puts Onyx first for context retrieval

onyx_url.title: Onyx URL
onyx_url.description: Your Onyx web address without a trailing slash, for example https://cloud.onyx.app

onyx_api_token.title: Onyx API token
onyx_api_token.description: A personal access token or API key with the read:search scope

strict_retrieval.title: Strict retrieval
strict_retrieval.description: Block other search tools until Onyx has been consulted for the current prompt
